scope: React web component and Hook contracts, state, Effects, rendering and server/client boundaries; supplements JavaScript and front-end review, excludes React Native and style preferences.
inputs: Captured crew selection and affected references
Trusted consumer guidance and installed React/framework versions
Exact-source hosted CI and sanitized evidence
checks: Trace component and Hook contracts, state ownership, render purity and affected callers.
Check Effect dependencies, cleanup, async ordering and component identity against actual user transitions.
Inspect applicable hydration, server/client trust, form and accessibility boundaries.
Assess behavior-oriented test evidence and request independent browser verification; avoid style and speculative performance findings.
evidenceRules: Cite owning code, affected interaction and a concrete consequence with a proportionate correction.
Report missing required evidence as blocked, not a pass.
Do not infer runtime behavior from source-only review.
